![What are THC diamonds and how are they made? | Weedmaps](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-fe0f114e0ade:4)
THC diamonds are solid, crystal-like cannabis concentrates made of nearly pure THCa that turn into potent THC when heated.[[1]](https://recovered.org/marijuana/thca/thc-diamonds)[[2]](https://thelibrarynj.com/blog/thc-diamonds-complete-guide/)

### What They Look Like and Potency

- **Appearance:** They look like clear or light yellow tiny gemstones or raw quartz.
- **Strength:** They test at **96% to 99.9%** pure THCa, making them the strongest cannabis extract you can buy.
- **Raw State:** In solid form, THCa does not get you high until heat changes it.[[1]](https://www.thetravelagency.co/what-are-thc-diamonds/)[[2]](https://thelibrarynj.com/blog/thc-diamonds-complete-guide/)[[3]](https://recovered.org/marijuana/thca/thc-diamonds)

### How to Use Them

- **Dabbing:** Place a tiny piece on a hot dab rig nail to vaporize and inhale.
- **Topping Flower:** Crush the crystals into a powder and sprinkle them over a bowl or joint.
- **Vaping:** Some vape carts mix melted diamonds with liquid terpene sauce.[[1]](https://fluresh.com/liquid-diamonds/)[[2]](https://recovered.org/marijuana/thca/thc-diamonds)[[3]](https://leafwell.com/blog/thc-crystals-crystalline)[[4]](https://elevatecannabis.com/higher-ed/what-are-thc-diamonds-and-how-to-smoke-them/)

If you want to try them, let me know:

- Are you looking for **pure solid diamonds** or a **liquid diamond vape**?
- Do you have experience with **dabbing concentrates**?
